system.description: The first time you hit with a Favored attack on a Turn with a Finesse, Keen, or Ranged Weapon, it deals an extra [[/r {{feature-value:1:1}}d4#Sneak Attack]]{{{feature-value:1:1}}d4} damage and ignores an amount of Armor equal to this number of extra dice. The number of extra d4s increases by 1 every 3 Levels hereafter.
